_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the product's brand. Edit THIS file, drop new images into brand/assets/, then run `npm run brand:sync`. Every surface (the app, the website, the press kit, email, app metadata) reads from here. Plain-language guide: ../HOW-TO-REBRAND.md. Do NOT hand-edit generated files (src/config/brand.ts, src/styles/brand-tokens.css, website/styles/brand.css) — change this and re-run sync.
name: Advisor Prep Hero
tagline: The private intelligence layer for a financial advisory practice.
taglineShort: Local-first workspace for confidential client work.
positioning: the private place your whole practice lives, and it answers you back

descriptions.store: Advisor Prep Hero is a local-first AI workspace for financial advisors who handle confidential client work. Your files stay on your machine. Bring your own API key or run AI models locally with Ollama. Supports RIAs, advisors, CPAs, and consultants where client confidentiality is non-negotiable.
descriptions.shortStore: Local-first AI workspace for confidential client work
descriptions.meta: Find anything you have ever emailed or filed, with cited answers. Redline in real Word. Your client files never leave your machine. Built for financial advisors and RIAs.

colors._readme: The four primitive brand colors. Everything else (alpha tints, sidebar, action buttons) is DERIVED from these in src/styles/globals.css via the --kp-navy-rgb / --kp-accent-rgb triples, so changing a value here propagates everywhere. Use 6-digit lowercase hex.

messaging._readme: Identity-bearing strings the app and exports show. Body copy keeps living in the UI and references the name via BRAND.name; only the identity hooks live here.

urls._readme: Display-facing brand URLs/addresses. These are the only values user-facing copy may show or link to. NOTE: licenseApi/firmApi are internal service endpoints; the locked copies are the authority for brand-sync assertions.

assets._readme: Source images, relative to brand/. Drop replacements here with the SAME filenames, then run sync — it copies them to every destination and regenerates the derived favicon/app-icon sizes.

lockedIdentifiers._readme: 🚨 These are the LANTERN permanent-plumbing values (pre-launch flip 2026-06-30 — no migration needed, no existing users). brand-sync READS them only to ASSERT they are still present and untouched in the codebase. Changing any after launch is a founder + ops decision that needs a migration release. See HOW-TO-REBRAND.md § 'The locked layer'.
